$schema_comment: Hooks that automate verification. The harness executes these, not the agent, so they cannot be bypassed.

hooks.description: After editing or writing files, run tests and show summary.

hooks.command: ./init.sh > /tmp/harness_init.log 2>&1 && echo '[harness] init.sh OK' || (echo '[harness] init.sh FAILED — check /tmp/harness_init.log before closing' && tail -20 /tmp/harness_init.log)
hooks.description: Before closing the session, force a full verification.
